verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec falls outside what a buyer comparing law firms would reasonably ask for. Its 'legal tech' and software-supported YSolutions unit are internal service-delivery tools, not a documented developer API. The probe finding no OpenAPI files at common paths fits this: no evidence shows the firm ships an API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
